notes: A simpler exact-SVP algorithm with the same leading time and space as ADRS15. The abstract explicitly removes a rejection-sampling step from ADRS. This is an equal-exponent algorithmic milestone; it does not lower the standing exponent below 1. The paper’s approximate-CVP statement has its own regime and is not used as an exact-SVP assumption.

extra.success: Randomized exact-SVP guarantee stated by the source
